explanation: Lemma 5.1 itself cites Bounebache--Zambotti Proposition 2.5 as giving unqualified absolute continuity of the resolvent with respect to mu. The reviewer says that proposition only gives the result for mu-a.e. initial point, so the overstatement is in Lemma 5.1; Proposition 5 and Lemma 6.1 are downstream uses of that flawed lemma.
